ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN? (1 mark)
   A. Use Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN.
   C. Apply the teaching of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic etiquettes has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes.
   D. Use Islamic etiquettes to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand? (1 mark)
   A. Use Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic phrases? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic phrases.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic phrases to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic phrases has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Environment School cleanliness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Environment School cleanliness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Environment School cleanliness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment School cleanliness.
   D. Say Environment School cleanliness has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Love for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love for parents.
   B. Say Love for parents has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Love for parents to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Birth of Prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Birth of Prophet has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Prophet.

14. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Jum’ah FESTIVALS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Birth of Prophet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic etiquettes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
